findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ai-chat, tool_web_read · Private data: ai-chat, ai-token-audit, token-safety-pack, wallet-profile, erc20-balance, token-price, tool_token_verdict, tool_token_honeypot, tool_wallet_profile, tool_ai_research-pro, tool_sol_tokens, tool_token_dexscreener · Public sink: x402-demand-report · Destructive: /pack/buy/starter, /pack/buy/pro, /pack/buy/business.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ai-chat, tool_web_read · Private data: ai-chat, ai-token-audit, token-safety-pack, wallet-profile, erc20-balance, token-price, tool_token_verdict, tool_token_honeypot, tool_wallet_profile, tool_ai_research-pro, tool_sol_tokens, tool_token_dexscreener · Public sink: x402-demand-report · Destructive: /pack/buy/starter, /pack/buy/pro, /pack/buy/business

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
